trips.name: Tokyo Family Trip
trips.description: First overseas trip with the baby — keeping the pace slow with plenty of stroller-friendly stops.

hotels.name: Shinjuku Gracery Hotel
hotels.parkingLocation: Hotel basement garage, entrance on the west side, about ¥2,000/night.
hotels.specialNote: Booking ref #JP-88213. Asked for a high floor, away from the elevator.
hotels.babyNote: Requested a crib in advance — confirmed available. Kettle in room for bottle prep.

hotels.name: Asakusa View Hotel
hotels.specialNote: Breakfast included. Ask front desk for a late checkout if the morning goes long.
hotels.babyNote: Quiet floor requested. Elevator to lobby is right next to the room.

entries.heading: Airport Transfer
entries.expectNote: Airport limousine bus takes about 90 minutes depending on traffic. Buy tickets at the counter after baggage claim.
entries.ticketNote: Airport Limousine Bus — buy on arrival, no need to book ahead.
entries.babyNote: Bring a bottle for the ride, baby will likely be overtired from the flight.

entries.heading: Dinner at Omoide Yokocho
entries.expectNote: Narrow alleys, can be smoky and crowded — good for a quick look rather than a full dinner with the stroller.
entries.parkingNote: No parking needed, walking distance from hotel.
entries.babyNote: Stroller access is tight in the alley — consider babywearing instead.

entries.heading: Ueno Zoo
entries.expectNote: Panda enclosure gets busy after 10am. Plenty of shaded benches for feeding stops.
entries.ticketNote: Buy tickets online in advance to skip the entrance line.
entries.babyNote: Nursing room and diaper-change station near the main gate.

entries.heading: Senso-ji Temple
entries.expectNote: Nakamise shopping street is fully pedestrian and stroller-friendly, but very crowded on weekends.
entries.ticketNote: Free entry to the temple grounds.
entries.babyNote: Bring a sun hat — the main approach street has little shade.

entries.heading: teamLab Planets
entries.expectNote: Some rooms involve wading through shallow water — bring a spare change of clothes for everyone.
entries.ticketNote: Timed-entry tickets sell out days ahead — book online now.
entries.parkingNote: No dedicated parking; nearest paid lot is a 5 minute walk, about ¥600/hour.
entries.babyNote: Strollers are not allowed inside — bring the baby carrier instead.
